title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 7, section 15 (Tweedsmuir Park)
heading: Tweedsmuir Park
sourceText:
Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Tweedsmuir Park
15 That portion of M.U. 5-11, within the boundaries of Tweedsmuir Park, 0.4 km either side of the centre line of Highway 20 between Young Creek and the westerly boundary of Tweedsmuir Park.
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
